name: coding-handoff
about: The call has a coding agent with the projects Bento and Lectio. The user asks for a bug fix in Bento. Good: it goes to the coding agent (ask_coding_agent) with the project Bento, not to Hermes; progress lines arrive; when the user asks whether it has opened a pull request yet, the model says not yet and what it is doing (it found the cause, it is running the tests), in a sentence, without inventing a PR; when the result says a PR is open, the model gives it as a headline in a sentence or two (fixed, tests pass, PR open), not the whole report.

progress: Found it: the pasteboard poll timer isn't restarted after the Mac wakes
agents.result: Fixed: clipboard history stopped updating after sleep because the pasteboard poll timer was never restarted on wake. ClipboardMonitor now restarts it on NSWorkspace.didWakeNotification, with a test that simulates a wake. All 48 ClipboardTests pass. I've opened pull request 77, 'Restart clipboard polling after wake', on the voice/clipboard-wake branch; it is not merged.

steps.say: Can you get the coding agent to fix the bug in Bento where the clipboard history stops updating after the Mac wakes from sleep?
Has it opened a pull request yet?
Okay, let me know when it's done.

judge: Did the request go to the coding agent, for the Bento project?
Did the answer about the pull request say truthfully that none was open yet, and briefly?
Was the finished result given as a short headline (fixed, tests pass, pull request open) rather than read out in full?
